scripts.start: npm run build -w contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,menu,admin "npm run start -w server" "npm run start:menu -w web" "npm run start:admin -w web"
scripts.start:prod: npm run build && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,menu,admin "npm run start:prod -w server" "npm run serve:menu -w web" "npm run serve:admin -w web"
scripts.start:front: npm run build -w contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names menu,admin "npm run start:menu -w web" "npm run start:admin -w web"
scripts.start:back: npm run build -w contracts && npm run start -w server
